change_interpretations.engineering_summary: The accelerator pedal demand threshold for mandatory 100 ms torque response was raised from 70% to 90%, narrowing the condition where 100 ms timing applies.

assessments.reason: TV-001 tests pedal step response at 75% pedal demand, which no longer triggers VCU-DR-01 now that the threshold was raised from 70% to 90%. The procedure must be updated to test above 90% demand and re-run to establish valid evidence.
assessments.recommended_action: Update test procedure to step pedal demand above 90% (e.g. 95%) and rerun.

assessments.reason: TV-002 evaluates brake arbitration using an 85% pedal input, which is below the revised 90% threshold for VCU-DR-01. To verify arbitration while VCU-DR-01 torque response is active, the procedure must be updated to exceed 90% pedal and re-tested.
assessments.recommended_action: Update test procedure to apply pedal demand >90% during emergency brake arbitration and rerun.

assessments.reason: TV-003 sweeps pedal demand from 75% to 95%, which covers the new >90% range, and recorded 92 ms maximum response time within the 100 ms limit. Although the requirement link is missing, existing evidence demonstrates compliance with the relaxed requirement.
assessments.recommended_action: Maintain existing pass evidence; owner may reconcile missing requirement link to VCU-DR-01.

assessments.reason: TV-004 measures emergency brake latency under VCU-BRK-03, which is unchanged. Workshop notes confirm brake latency uses a different clock and is not conflated with positive torque latency.
evidence: Workshop note: Brake latency and positive torque latency use different clocks

assessments.reason: TV-005 verifies wheel-speed sensor failure diagnostics under VCU-DGN-04, which is not modified by this change.
TV-006 verifies mode event logging under VCU-LOG-05, which is unchanged in this revision.

TV-007 specifies an 80% pedal demand test with a TBD requirement link and was NOT RUN. Because 80% pedal falls below the new 90% threshold of VCU-DR-01, owner review is required to clarify mapping and test scope.
assessments.recommended_action: Owner must clarify requirement link and decide whether to update pedal level above 90% or re-scope.

assessments.reason: TV-008 is a legacy diagnostic trace replay referencing VCU-OLD-88, completely unrelated to driver torque response VCU-DR-01.
TV-009 verifies Sport vs Comfort torque ramp profiles under VCU-MOD-06 without quantitative response-time assertions.
TV-010 verifies pedal signal transient spike filtering under VCU-DR-02, which remains unchanged.
TV-011 tests emergency brake override priority over positive torque under VCU-BRK-03, which is unchanged.
TV-012 evaluates ECU power cycle startup timing, which is independent of driver pedal response specifications.
evidence: Procedure measures ECU power cycle readiness within 500 ms
